layout.title: Hudson Tuf-Lite III 6000MK Series Hub | Cooling Tower Fans

paragraphs: Adjustable Pitch Fan Assembly 32.8′ or 10 Meter Diameter. Blade Counts from 6 to 20.

Hudson Tuf-Lite III 6000MK Series fan blades are of single piece fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) construction optimized for performance, reliability, noise, and cost effectiveness. Tuf-Lite III fan blades are constructed of light weight, corrosion resistant, fiberglass reinforced vinyl-ester resin, with materials, thickness, and processes determined from finite element analysis modeling. Tuf-Edge leading-edge erosion and UV protection come standard with this blade.
